scope: LIVREUR / DeliveryBoy daily flow (admin oversight + cash session + IDOR + BranchScope)
verdict_summary: 1 P0 (UI broken via double /api prefix), 1 P0 (PII leak — raw scaffold token displayed), 2 P1 (audit-chain integration gap, no livreur self-service UI), 0 P2 critical. BranchScope + IDOR defenses sound at backend layer.

findings.title: Cash sessions list shows 'Aucune donnée disponible' — XHR hits double /api/api/ path returning SPA catchall HTML

evidence.ui_effect: Vue parses res.data.data || [] from HTML body → sessions = []

findings.reproduction: Login admin → navigate /admin/delivery-boy-cash-sessions → DB has 1 OPEN session (id=1, branch=1, livreur_id=10) → list renders empty state. Same call from devtools network: status 200, Content-Type=text/html, body=DOCTYPE.
findings.impact: Livreur cash drawer cockpit completely non-functional. Manager cannot see open sessions, close, or reconcile — NF525 audit cockpit blind. Affects also detail page (/admin/delivery-boy-cash-sessions/:id) — see screenshot 03 (blank).
findings.fix_hint: Strip leading '/api' from URLs in DeliveryBoyCashSessionListComponent.vue:180 AND DeliveryBoyCashSessionShowComponent.vue / FormComponent.vue. Pattern in peer files like dashboard widgets uses bare '/admin/...' paths.

findings.title: PII / scaffold artifact leaked — livreur phone column shows raw 'PENDING_CREATE_331502b3385a' token in admin list
findings.reproduction: Login admin → /admin/delivery-boys → table shows scaffold placeholder rather than NULL or real phone.
findings.impact: Owner-visible UI defect on a release-candidate branch. Suggests E2E seeder (livreur.e2e) left scaffold sentinel in production DB after restore 2026-05-28. Either the seeder needs to set NULL/empty or list must coalesce 'PENDING_CREATE_*' → '—'.
findings.fix_hint: Either (a) sanitize at DeliveryBoyResource boundary — strip 'PENDING_CREATE_*'; or (b) re-run seeder with valid phone null. Add CI sentinel against scaffold tokens in production-bound users table.

findings.title: DELIVERED hook writes 'delivery.cash_collected_escrow' but does NOT call DeliveryBoyCashSessionService::recordMovement → audit/movement chain integrity gap

evidence.search: grep DeliveryBoyCashSessionService usage in app/Services/ → ONLY ZReportCashEnrichmentService (read) + self. NO call site from OrderService when COD DELIVERED.

findings.reproduction: Trace COD order: PREPARED→OUT_FOR_DELIVERY→DELIVERED writes audit_log row 'delivery.cash_collected_escrow' on order. No corresponding cash_movement row inserted on the livreur's open session → verifyConsistencyVsAuditLog() will fire 'count_mismatch' / 'movement_missing_audit_row' until manual recordMovement runs.
findings.impact: Z-report enrichment / NF525 verification probe will flag drift for COD deliveries on V1 LIVREUR cycle. Service exists with strict=false best-effort hook documented in DeliveryBoyCashSessionService L286-294 docblock, but no caller. Architecturally documented as Path B decoupling but not connected.
findings.fix_hint: Add a best-effort call to DeliveryBoyCashSessionService::recordMovement(sessionId, 'order_collect', amount, 'in', orderId) AFTER cash_collected_escrow audit in OrderService L1824. session lookup via findOpenSessionForDeliveryBoy($branchId, $driverId). Strict=false so missing session → log warning, no 5xx for customer.

findings.title: No livreur self-service UI in V1 — backend-only. Livreur logs into admin shell and sees admin pages (not a dedicated mobile/PWA flow)

evidence.file_b: app/Http/Controllers/Admin/DeliveryBoyCashSessionController.php:20 docblock — 'The livreur self-service surface (/api/frontend/delivery-boy-shift/*) is a separate controller (Wave 6b-1.3b) — not part of this BUILD-1 scope.'
evidence.search_routes: grep -rn 'delivery-boy-shift|FrontendDeliveryBoy' routes/ → ZERO matches. The promised Wave 6b-1.3b never landed.

findings.reproduction: Login as livreur (user_id=10, email livreur.e2e@lecayenne.test, role 'Delivery Boy') → landing redirects to /admin/delivery-boys which the livreur role likely cannot fully access (depends on RBAC grants). No PWA / mobile flow / shift-open self-service screen.
findings.impact: In production, the livreur must be opened/closed/reconciled BY the admin/manager from the admin desktop UI (DeliveryBoyCashSessionShowComponent / FormComponent embedded in DeliveryBoyShow tabs). For V1 LOCAL Le Cayenne (owner = single operator) this is acceptable per CLAUDE.md feedback_v1_personal_le_cayenne, but Master Plan claims 'cash session opening/closing flow' delivered. Doc + plan vs reality drift.
findings.fix_hint: Either (a) document explicitly in PROJECT_BRAIN.md §3 that V1 livreur has NO self-service UI and shift open/close runs from admin only; or (b) ship the deferred /api/frontend/delivery-boy-shift/* controller + a small PWA card in mobile app. For V1 Le Cayenne (a) is sufficient.

findings.title: BranchScope coverage verified on DeliveryBoyCashSession + DeliveryBoyCashMovement

evidence.sentinel: tests/Feature/Branch/BranchScopeCoverageSentinelTest.php auto-detects branch_id column → both pass (not in EXEMPTED_MODELS).
evidence.tinker_check: Auth as admin (branch_id=0) sees 1 session. Auth as livreur (branch_id=1) sees 1 session (own branch). Cross-branch read isolated by global scope.

findings.title: IDOR mitigated on session detail — route binding 'DeliveryBoyCashSession $session' enforces BranchScope; cross-branch returns 404

evidence.service: DeliveryBoyCashSessionService::openSession L82-96 uses withoutGlobalScope explicitly + Cache::lock + lockForUpdate + UNIQUE partial index (3-layer defense).
evidence.form_request: DeliveryBoyCashSessionOpenRequest.php:50-67 — withoutGlobalScope for cross-branch admin context; asserts target user has DELIVERY_BOY role + branch assignment; uses singular Z6-P1-WGS form preserving SoftDeletingScope (soft-deleted livreur cannot reopen).

findings.title: NF525 invariants on cash session lifecycle solid

evidence.I1: openSession refuses duplicate OPEN via Cache::lock + lockForUpdate + DB UNIQUE partial index uk_branch_livreur_open (migration 2026_05_18_120200)
evidence.I2: closeSession refuses reconciled; idempotent on closed
evidence.I3: reconcile computes expected = opening + Σ(signed movements) → variance = closing - expected
evidence.I4: DB no-delete triggers migration 2026_05_18_120300 — DELETE forbidden SQLSTATE '45000'
evidence.audit_chain: service writes via AuditLogService::write() under namespace 'cash.delivery.session.*' + 'cash.delivery.movement.*'
